$description: Wingtip Maps' screens and the one link that opens each, the source for the web, iOS and Android (docs/navigation.md). A link is the web app's own address, https://<host>/app/plan?open=<id>, with the plan's own keys beside it (dep, dest, stops, place, flight); the phones take the same address as a universal link or App Link, and as wingtipmaps://plan?open=<id> from another app. scripts/build/screens.sh generates apps/web/src/lib/navigation/generated/screens.ts, apps/ios/Wingtip/Navigation/Generated/Screens.swift, apps/android/app/src/main/kotlin/app/wingtipmaps/android/navigation/generated/Screens.kt and docs/navigation.md's table of links from it; CI generates them again and fails on a difference. Each app opens a screen it has in one exhaustive switch over the generated list, so a screen added here fails each app's build until that app opens it. Add a screen here, never in a generated file.
